sources.title: [26.18] You can't milk those! - A comprehensive Alistar guide.

passive.name: Triumphant Roar
passive.text: Alistar charges his roar by stunning or displacing enemy champions or when nearby enemies die. When fully charged he heals himself all nearby allied champions.

spells.name: Pulverize
spells.text: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air.

spells.name: Headbutt
spells.text: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.

spells.name: Trample
spells.text: Alistar tramples nearby enemy units, ignoring unit collision and gaining stacks if he damages an enemy champion. At full stacks Alistar's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals additional magic damage and stuns them.

spells.name: Unbreakable Will
spells.text: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.

damage.value: Alistar deals sustained damage with Trample and additional magic damage on a fully stacked basic attack.

archetype.value: Alistar is a melee support who engages and locks down targets in teamfights.

axis.value: Alistar plays lane around engages, but cannot play lane before level 2.

winCondition.value: Alistar can turn a losing game around with a single teamfight engage.

spikes.why: Alistar's next basic attack against an enemy champion gains magic damage and a stun.

bait.why: After Alistar uses Unbreakable Will, its crowd-control removal and damage reduction are unavailable until the cooldown ends.
